triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: Yes, formally and solemnly betrothed. It was all done on my arrival in Moscow, with great ceremony, with ikons, all in fine style.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: ‘I love you madly,’ she says, ‘even if you don’t love me, never mind. Be my husband.

triples.subject: Ivan Karamazov
triples.quote: Yes, Ivan fell in love with her; he’s in love with her still. I know that.

triples.subject: Ivan Karamazov
triples.quote: Yes, Ivan fell in love with her; he’s in love with her still. I know that.

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: What, do you suppose I’d shoot myself because I can’t get three thousand to pay back?

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: So I had that three thousand roubles in my pocket when I went to see Grushenka, and it was that money we spent at Mokroe.

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: I went in the first place to beat her.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: “There’s something in it, brother, that no woman could forgive. Do you know what would be the best thing to do?”

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: “Mitya, dear, what’s the matter with you?” cried Alyosha, jumping up from his place, and looking keenly at his brother’s frenzied face.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: “I’ll be her husband if she deigns to have me, and when lovers come, I’ll go into the next room. I’ll clean her friends’ goloshes, blow up their samovar, run their errands.”

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: he found out for the first time _in earnest_ (underline _in earnest_) that Grushenka is really perhaps not joking, and really means to marry me.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: Here is your three thousand; he sends it back. Send it yourself to Agafya Ivanovna. But he told me to say “he sends his compliments.”
